narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are seven levels of three. Three times seven is twenty one diamonds.
<bookmark mark='nine'/>Three times seven only adds seven threes together. But the baskets alone are already nine.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each level multiplies by three, so the threes must be multiplied together.
